public_posts.text: Afrikaner leaders from the Solidarity Movement, AfriForum, Solidarity, SAAI, NEASA, and Freedom Front Plus met with the U.S. Ambassador to South Africa.
DA stalwart and former party leader, John Steenhuisen, said that white Afrikaners linked to Solidarity, Afriforum, Saai, and Sakeliga don’t share the party’s values.
Theo de Jager, executive director at Southern African Agri Initiative (SAAI), said that very few land reform projects have been successful.
AfriForum has filed a contempt of court application against EFF leader Julius Malema and his party over continued incitement to land occupation.
AfriForum CEO Kallie Kriel said they urged the United States to punish individuals such as Julius Malema and Fikile Mbalula rather than ordinary citizens.
President Cyril Ramaphosa has refused to condemn the Kill the Boer chant or declare rural crime a priority crime, which can cost South Africa 250,000 jobs.
The Democratic Alliance’s internal polling shows it is on the verge of overtaking the ANC as South Africa's largest party.
EFF leader Julius Malema said that they cannot join the government of national unity (GNU) as long as white parties like the DA and Freedom Front Plus are represented.
DA leader Geordin Hill-Lewis said years of ANC mismanagement and corruption destroyed every government department in South Africa.
